memory_candidates.content: Authoring a `## Lean Challenge Statements` block for a lean4 plan in BimodalLogic: the snapshot matcher (.claude/scripts/lean-challenge-snapshot.sh) recognizes only `theorem|lemma|def|instance` + a SIMPLE name, and for each match it keeps the text up to the first top-level `:=` and DISCARDS everything from there to the next match. Three consequences the design record (context/project/lean4/domain/challenge-snapshot.md) does not state: (1) every definitional carrier a pinned statement mentions must sit in the PREAMBLE, before the first matched declaration, because an `abbrev` or `structure` placed BETWEEN two theorems falls inside the preceding theorem's discarded chunk; (2) carriers must be written `abbrev`/`structure`, never `def`, so the matcher does not erase their bodies and they stay out of the cross-validated identifier set (the library then declares them with `def`); (3) no intervening `namespace`/`end` may sit between two pinned theorems, so every pinned name must be undotted AND globally distinct -- two namespace-local lemmas sharing a bare name (e.g. `Tr.ext` and `Beh.ext` both reducing to `ext`) cannot both be pinned and belong under a `**Goals (not challenge-pinned)**` bullet instead. Verify the assembled block by compiling it with `lake env lean`: the expected result is exit 0 with exactly one `declaration uses 'sorry'` warning per pinned identifier.
